notes: The per-file numbers sum higher than the total on purpose: what costs a session is all of them
together, and the per-file line is only there to stop one document eating the whole allowance.
The total is the real constraint and is a hard ceiling.
src/CLAUDE.md moved from 6000 to 6500 deliberately. 6000 was the file's size on the day the
budget was written, rounded up — a snapshot rather than a target, which is why it read 99% from
the first commit and every session since paid a word hunt to add a sentence. 6500 is chosen to
leave the document real working room. The total did not move.
